question: Can Taiwan dealer proprietary versus hedge trading be replayed with official stock-level semantics and point-in-time-safe provenance for research without changing current Formal dealerNet?

paidProduct.semantics: prop and hedge buy/sell fields separately defined

TPEx.publicHistory: detail data available since ROC 96/04/20 with older historical query routes

system2RetrospectiveReplay.note: retrospective schema/coverage proof only; not publication-latency evidence

sourceSemanticsGuard: dealer proprietary and dealer hedge are economically distinct source fields and must remain separate in research receipts
foreign dealer is also a separate official source field and must not be silently relabeled as ordinary foreign investor flow
historical replay proves finalized date-specific values, not the exact historical firstKnownAt
future decision-time PIT uses actual capturedAt and official production clock where verified
unknown field order/schema fingerprint fails closed rather than guessing indexes

formalCompressionBoundary.currentFormalState: Current Formal institutional snapshot persists only aggregate dealerNet; TWSE/TPEx prop+hedge detail is collapsed before scoring.
formalCompressionBoundary.implication: D06-03 research maturity may advance independently of Formal runtime field preservation.
formalCompressionBoundary.classB: Preserving prop/hedge split in shared runtime/research persistence requires proposal-first if shared source path changes.
formalCompressionBoundary.classC: Any change to institutionalScore weights/signs/thresholds remains owner-approved Formal work only.

falsification: A replayable source does not prove prop flow or hedge flow is predictive.
Hedge activity is not automatically noise; proprietary activity is not automatically informed conviction.
Historical finalized pages cannot fabricate historical publication timestamps.
The current Formal aggregate dealerNet cannot be decomposed retrospectively from persisted rows if the split was not saved.
TPEx schema drift remains a fail-closed risk; research receipts must preserve source field semantics/fingerprint.

maturityDecision.basis: Taiwan official TWSE and TPEx stock-level source semantics are separately defined and date-specific replay feasibility has been validated; research can preserve PIT-safe provenance prospectively. No outcome claim and no Formal adoption is implied.

exactNext: Prospectively preserve dealer-proprietary and dealer-hedge split receipts on independent trading dates, then only at L4 test incremental value versus aggregate dealerNet, price-volume, derivatives/passive context and market regime. No Formal score change.
